votes.motion: Approve Work Session meeting minutes from April 13, 2021; April 20, 2021; September 7, 2021, and Formal Meeting minutes from September 7, 2021; as well as the meeting minute excerpts relating to Delegating GO Bond actions from September 21, 2021.
votes.description: Approval of several prior meeting minutes, including work session and formal session minutes, and excerpts related to GO Bond actions.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the proposed ordinance to partially vacate a portion of 14th Avenue adjacent to 538 East 14th Avenue.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a street vacation near 538 East 14th Avenue and defers a final decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 60 of 2021, amending the FY2021-2022 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document, including a Switchpoint contract encumbrance carryforward and an FTE reclassification.
votes.description: Amends the City's FY2021-22 budget to re-authorize $2 million for Switchpoint to purchase the former Airport Inn as transitional housing and reclassifies a Council Office staff position.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 56 of 2021, rezoning and amending the Master Plan for properties at 554 and 560 South 300 East.
votes.description: Rezones 554 and 560 South 300 East from RO to R-MU and amends the Central Community Master Plan Future Land Use Map to High Mixed Use designation.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 57 of 2021, regarding a Master Plan and Zoning Map amendment at 461 South 400 East.
votes.description: Rezones 461 South 400 East from R-MU-45 to TSA-UN-C and amends the Central Community Master Plan to High Density Transit Oriented Development to accommodate a mixed-use redevelopment.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 58 of 2021, rezoning 203 East 2100 South, 221 East 2100 South, and 1991 South 200 East, subject to a Development Agreement requiring ½ on-site parking stall per residential dwelling unit.
votes.description: Rezones three properties from RMF-45 to FB-UN2 and amends the Central Community Master Plan to allow mixed-use development, conditioned on a development agreement for minimum parking.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 59 of 2021, to vacate a portion of City-owned alley adjacent to 968, 974, 980 East Elm Avenue and 2188 South 1000 East.
votes.description: Vacates a segment of a City-owned alley adjacent to four properties on Elm Avenue and 1000 East, citing public safety and lack of use.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 61 of 2021, amending and restating Chapter 3.04 of Salt Lake City Code relating to local sales and use taxes.
votes.description: A housekeeping ordinance that restates City code on local sales and use taxes to align it with current state law.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 61 of 2021, enacting temporary zoning regulations authorizing temporary overflow homeless shelter use at approximately 235 South Rio Grande.
votes.description: Enacts temporary land use regulations to allow a temporary overflow homeless shelter at the Weigand Center location for the winter season.

votes.motion: Approve Grants 1 through 7 of Grant Holding Account Item (Consent Agenda No. 2 for Budget Amendment No. 3).
votes.description: Approves seven grant items associated with Budget Amendment No. 3 for FY2021-22; Grant No. 8 had previously been adopted on October 5th.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda, except for Item 2 – Appointment of Nathan Manuel to the PNUT Board, which will be rescheduled at a later date.
votes.description: Approves consent agenda items including setting a public hearing date for a rezone at 1945 South 1300 East and setting a public hearing date for the Digital Donation Program resolution, while deferring the Nathan Manuel PNUT Board appointment.
